newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SNORAS BANK SAYS Q1 PROFIT 3.82 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SNORAS BANK SAYS Q1 PROFIT 3.82 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Snoras bank said on Wednesday its net profit for the first quarter of 1997 was 3.82 million litas compared to 23,000 litas in losses in the same period last year.

"The bank's net profit in the first three month of the year was 3.82 million litas versus 23,000 litas in losses in the first quarter of 1996," the chairman of the bank's board, Raimondas Baranauskas, told Reuters.
Baranauskas said that Snoras' assets at the end of March were 400.4 million litas compared with 411.6 million litas at the end of February.
He also said that the loan portfolio of the bank was 38.67 million litas and that deposits were 271.56 million litas at the end of March compared with 269.8 million litas at the end of February.
Baranauskas added that the bank met the risk limiting requirements of the central bank and its capital adequacy was 11.2 percent while its liquidity ratio was 111.89.
Baranauskas said that the bank decided to audit its results every quarter of this year and signed an agreemnet with Arthur & Andersen audit company.
